title: Sealing the Vale barrow reads as if you trap yourself: 'You draw the great doors shut from within the passage and hear the seal-stone drop.' For a moment it looks like a softlock (exits at the throne then only showed S/D, no 'out'), though walking south through the crypt and antechamber let the whole party leave normally.
where: The Empty Seat (Vale barrow) / 'seal the barrow doors behind you'
